canonical.question: What same-day reservation rule and date-amendment deadline does the National Rail refunds and changes guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: You can change your reservation, class and route, providing the conditions of your ticket allow it.
canonical.expected_secondary: You cannot amend the date of Anytime tickets, Off-Peak tickets, Day Travelcards and most Ranger tickets and Rover tickets after 23:59 on the day before travel.
canonical.tampered_primary: You can change your reservation, passenger, class and route without conditions.
